prompt: This program hangs waiting for input even after all data is supposedly passed. Why?
choices: hasNextLine() does not work in a loop
In a terminal, System.in has no EOF until the user signals it with Ctrl+D (Unix) or Ctrl+Z (Windows)
sc.nextLine() must be called inside a try-catch
explanation: hasNextLine() blocks until there is more input or EOF. In an interactive terminal, EOF is only sent when the user presses Ctrl+D (Unix) or Ctrl+Z+Enter (Windows). When reading from a file ('java App < data.txt'), EOF is detected at end of file and the loop terminates.
